description: Metric registry (HAR-97 CANONICAL EVAL STRATEGY, HAR-140 / WP36): the 268 entries migrated from the legacy combined registry (ids unchanged; contracts/metrics/legacy_id_map.json), the canonical headline-only metrics, the frontier V5 and V6 entries, the 11-item headline set and, separately, the operational diagnostics M1-M5. A METRIC aggregates evals; an eval is judged in contracts/evals/eval_registry.json (field `evals` links them). Status: measured (value in the repo, with its source), computable (data, gold and code exist; only the run or scorer is missing), blocked (a component, data or gold is missing: see blocker). bench/metrics/report.py recomputes the measured values; docs/metrics*.md are generated from this file. Operational diagnostics never mutate GTM company knowledge.
